method.summary: TypeScript 5.8.3 type-checker census over a git archive snapshot of src/ and scripts/ at audited_sha (tsconfig.json root files plus scripts/**/*.ts; node_modules = per-entry junctions, type information only, nothing executed). Every CallExpression is classified by the TYPE of its receiver; contract runners and ABIs are traced to their constructions; lock status follows reference chains through the TypeScript language service (findReferences), cycle-safe, and requires every hop to be awaited or returned.
method.tx_signing: sendTransaction/signTransaction on a Signer type; ContractFactory.deploy; state-changing contract method calls and .send on a Signer-runner Contract; Flashbots signBundle/sendBundle/sendRawBundle/sendPrivateTransaction; in-program rawSendBundle/sendRawBundle; unresolved receivers (type_unresolved, lock unknown)
method.message_signing: signMessage/signTypedData on a Signer (no nonce; never a D-NONCE-AUTHORITY-ALL violation)
method.excluded: view/pure ABI fragments, .staticCall/.estimateGas/.populateTransaction, getDeployTransaction (census), and auditor exclusions with evidence (manual inventory)
method.lock: locked lexical = the site function is the op of withNonceLock; locked transitive = every reference chain ends in such an op with every hop awaited/returned; unlocked = a chain reaches module top level, an event/route callback or an exported function with no in-program caller; unknown = unresolved type, unfollowable callback/value use, un-awaited hop, no reference
method.in_process_only: the lock is per process; a script is a separate process with its own lock (AUD-SCRIPTS-002)
